test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: The average of 25, 46 and ‘y’ is 11. What is the value of ‘y’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 3 numbers = Average × 3 = 11 × 3 = 33

Sum of given numbers = 25 + 46 = 71

Value of y = Total sum − Sum of given numbers

y = 33 − 71 = −38

**∴ The correct answer is −38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 25, 46, and y

Average of these 3 numbers = 11

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69cfcd35a332b12b4b672f193863117dd4323996e082f0ee367db65b93181f44.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Average = (25 + 46 + y) ÷ 3

⇒ 11 = (71 + y) ÷ 3

⇒ 11 × 3 = 71 + y

⇒ 33 = 71 + y

⇒ y = 33 − 71

⇒ y = −38

**∴ The correct answer is −38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Observations

The sum of n observations is always equal to the product of their average and the total count n. Sum = Average × n.

Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all observations from their arithmetic mean (average) is always zero. ∑(xᵢ − Average) = 0.

Weighted Average

When different groups have different averages, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
